tasks.task_name: Establish core team structure and staffing plan
tasks.description:
Define and document the project team organizational structure consisting of 4-5 people with clearly delineated roles. This task implements the core team structure requirement from Section 6.1 of the requirement specification.

The team structure must include:
- 1 Product Manager
- 1 Technical Lead
- 2 Backend/CLI Developers
- 1 Quality Assurance engineer

This foundational task establishes the human resource framework that all subsequent role-specific tasks depend upon. The structure should be documented in a format that clearly shows reporting relationships and collaboration patterns.
tasks.task_notes: This is a foundational task that must be completed before role-specific responsibilities can be assigned. Consider documenting communication channels, escalation paths, and collaboration tools as part of the structure definition.

requirement_snippets:
### **6.1 Core Team Structure**
```
Project Team (4-5 people)
├── Product Manager (1)
├── Technical Lead (1)
├── Backend/CLI Developer (2)
└── Quality Assurance (1)
```
constraints: Team must consist of exactly 4-5 people
Each role must have the specified number of positions
success_criteria: Team structure document created showing all 5 roles
Organizational chart clearly depicts reporting and collaboration relationships
Staffing plan identifies required headcount for each role

tasks.task_name: Define Product Manager role and responsibilities
tasks.description:
Establish comprehensive role definition for the Product Manager position as specified in Section 6.2.1 of the requirement specification. The Product Manager serves as the key liaison between stakeholders and the development team, with primary focus on product strategy, user requirements, and project coordination.

This task involves documenting all responsibilities, creating templates for MVP deliverables, and establishing processes that enable the Product Manager to effectively execute their duties. The role definition must be clear enough that a new hire can understand expectations and key performance indicators.

The Product Manager is responsible for the strategic direction of the CLI tool, including feature prioritization, user feedback integration, timeline management, and go-to-market planning.
tasks.task_notes: This role is critical for MVP success as it owns the definition of 'done' for the project. Consider creating templates or frameworks for each MVP deliverable to ensure consistency. The Product Manager should be involved in hiring decisions for other team members.

requirement_snippets:
#### **6.2.1 Product Manager**
**Responsibilities:**
- Define and prioritize feature roadmap
- Gather user requirements and feedback
- Coordinate between stakeholders and development team
- Manage project timeline and milestones
- Ensure business requirements are met
- User documentation and marketing materials

**MVP Deliverables:**
- User stories and acceptance criteria
- MVP scope definition
- User testing plan
- Go-to-market strategy for CLI tool
constraints: Must be exactly 1 Product Manager on the team
success_criteria: User stories and acceptance criteria are documented
MVP scope definition is completed and approved
User testing plan is created and ready for execution
Go-to-market strategy for CLI tool is documented
Feature roadmap is defined and prioritized
User requirements and feedback collection process is established
Stakeholder coordination mechanisms are in place
Project timeline and milestones are documented
Business requirements validation process is defined
User documentation and marketing materials are delivered
dependencies: Establish core team structure and staffing plan

tasks.task_name: Define Technical Lead role and responsibilities
tasks.description:
Establish comprehensive role definition for the Technical Lead position as specified in Section 6.2.2 of the requirement specification. The Technical Lead is responsible for all architectural decisions, code quality standards, and technical oversight of the project.

This task involves documenting technical responsibilities, establishing code review processes, defining quality standards, and creating mentorship frameworks. The Technical Lead serves as the primary technical authority and is responsible for ensuring the CLI tool integrates properly with the Notion API while maintaining high standards for performance and security.

The role includes hands-on implementation of core modules while providing technical guidance and mentorship to the Backend/CLI Developers.
tasks.task_notes: This role is critical for technical success and must have deep expertise in CLI development and API integration. Consider establishing technical decision-making frameworks, architecture documentation standards, and code review guidelines as part of role definition. The Technical Lead should establish engineering best practices early in the project lifecycle.

requirement_snippets:
#### **6.2.2 Technical Lead**
**Responsibilities:**
- Architecture design and technical decisions
- Code review and quality standards
- Implementation of core modules
- Integration with Notion API
- Performance and security oversight
- Mentoring other developers
constraints: Must be exactly 1 Technical Lead on the team
success_criteria: Architecture design documentation is completed
Technical decision-making framework is established
Code review process and quality standards are defined
Core modules implementation approach is documented
Notion API integration strategy is defined
Performance monitoring and optimization processes are established
Security review and oversight processes are defined
Developer mentoring program and guidelines are created
dependencies: Establish core team structure and staffing plan

tasks.task_name: Create Product Manager MVP deliverables templates
tasks.description:
Create standardized templates and frameworks for each of the four MVP deliverables that the Product Manager is responsible for producing. This task directly supports the Product Manager's ability to deliver consistent, high-quality outputs.

Templates must be created for:
1. User stories and acceptance criteria (format, structure, required fields)
2. MVP scope definition (sections, approval workflow, change management)
3. User testing plan (test scenarios, participant criteria, success metrics)
4. Go-to-market strategy for CLI tool (channels, messaging, launch timeline)

These templates ensure consistency, completeness, and alignment with project objectives while reducing rework and ambiguity.
tasks.task_notes: These templates should be living documents that can be refined based on team feedback. Consider including examples or sample content in each template. Templates should be stored in version control and easily accessible to all team members.

requirement_snippets:
**MVP Deliverables:**
- User stories and acceptance criteria
- MVP scope definition
- User testing plan
- Go-to-market strategy for CLI tool
constraints: Must cover all four MVP deliverables
Templates must be actionable and complete
success_criteria: User stories and acceptance criteria template is created with required fields and format
MVP scope definition template includes all necessary sections and approval workflow
User testing plan template covers test scenarios, participants, and metrics
Go-to-market strategy template addresses all key GTM components
All templates are reviewed and approved by Product Manager and Technical Lead
Templates are accessible in project repository
dependencies: Define Product Manager role and responsibilities

tasks.task_name: Establish Technical Lead code review and quality standards
tasks.description:
Define comprehensive code review processes and quality standards that the Technical Lead will enforce across the project. This task implements the Technical Lead's responsibility for maintaining code quality and establishing review protocols.

The deliverable should include:
- Code review workflow (when reviews are required, who reviews, approval criteria)
- Quality standards (coding conventions, documentation requirements, test coverage minimums)
- Review checklists (security, performance, maintainability, API integration correctness)
- Tools and automation (linters, formatters, static analysis)

These standards ensure consistent code quality, facilitate knowledge sharing, and reduce technical debt throughout the project lifecycle.
tasks.task_notes: Consider establishing different review requirements for different types of changes (e.g., critical vs. minor changes). Quality standards should be enforced through automation where possible to reduce manual review burden. Standards should be documented and easily discoverable by all developers.

requirement_snippets:
**Responsibilities:**
- Architecture design and technical decisions
- Code review and quality standards
- Implementation of core modules
- Integration with Notion API
- Performance and security oversight
constraints: Must support Technical Lead's oversight responsibilities
Must be enforceable through process and tooling
success_criteria: Code review workflow is documented and communicated to team
Quality standards document covers all critical areas (security, performance, maintainability)
Review checklists are created for common review scenarios
Automated quality checks are configured in CI/CD pipeline
Documentation standards are defined and enforced
Team training on code review process is completed
dependencies: Define Technical Lead role and responsibilities

tasks.description:
Create comprehensive architecture design for integrating the CLI tool with the Notion API. This task directly implements the Technical Lead's responsibility for Notion API integration and architecture design.

The architecture should address:
- API authentication and authorization mechanisms
- API endpoints to be utilized and their purpose
- Data models and mapping between CLI and Notion structures
- Error handling and retry logic
- Rate limiting and API quota management
- Caching strategies for performance optimization
- Security considerations for API credentials and data transmission

This is a foundational technical task that will guide all Backend/CLI Developer implementation work related to Notion integration.
tasks.task_notes: This is a critical path item that blocks CLI implementation. The Technical Lead should research Notion API capabilities, limitations, and best practices before finalizing the architecture. Consider creating architecture diagrams and sequence diagrams to illustrate integration flows. Security review of credential handling is essential.

requirement_snippets:
**Responsibilities:**
- Architecture design and technical decisions
- Integration with Notion API
- Performance and security oversight
constraints: Must integrate with official Notion API
success_criteria: Notion API integration architecture document is completed
Authentication and authorization approach is defined and secure
API endpoint usage is mapped to CLI functionality
Data models are designed and validated
Error handling strategy is comprehensive and user-friendly
Rate limiting and quota management approach is defined
Caching strategy is designed for optimal performance
Security review of integration design is completed
Architecture is reviewed and approved by Technical Lead
dependencies: Define Technical Lead role and responsibilities

tasks.task_name: Establish developer mentoring program and guidelines
tasks.description:
Create a structured mentoring program and guidelines that enable the Technical Lead to effectively mentor the Backend/CLI Developers. This task implements the Technical Lead's mentoring responsibility as specified in Section 6.2.2.

The program should include:
- Onboarding process for new developers
- Technical skill development paths
- Regular 1-on-1 mentoring session structure
- Code review as a teaching tool
- Knowledge sharing mechanisms (tech talks, documentation, pair programming)
- Growth objectives and feedback mechanisms

Effective mentoring ensures team capability growth, knowledge distribution, and sustainable development velocity.
tasks.task_notes: Mentoring is important for long-term team success but can be established after initial project setup. Consider creating mentoring templates and tracking mechanisms. The program should be flexible enough to adapt to individual developer needs while maintaining consistency in approach.

constraints: Must support Technical Lead's mentoring responsibility
Must be scalable to 2 Backend/CLI Developers
success_criteria: Developer onboarding process is documented
Technical skill development paths are defined
Mentoring session structure and frequency are established
Knowledge sharing mechanisms are implemented
Feedback and growth tracking process is created
Mentoring guidelines are reviewed and approved by Technical Lead
dependencies: Define Technical Lead role and responsibilities

tasks.task_name: Create team coordination and communication framework
tasks.description:
Establish the coordination and communication framework that enables the 4-5 person team to work effectively together. This task supports the Product Manager's responsibility to 'coordinate between stakeholders and development team' and ensures smooth collaboration across all roles.

The framework should define:
- Regular meeting cadence (standups, sprint planning, retrospectives)
- Communication channels and tools (chat, email, documentation)
- Decision-making processes and escalation paths
- Cross-functional workflows (requirement gathering to deployment)
- Status reporting and visibility mechanisms
- Stakeholder communication protocols

Effective coordination is essential for a small team to maximize productivity and minimize blockers.
tasks.task_notes: This framework should be lightweight and adapted to the team's needs rather than following rigid processes. Consider the Product Manager's coordination responsibilities when designing communication flows. The framework should facilitate rapid feedback and minimize overhead for a small team.

requirement_snippets:
**Responsibilities:**
- Coordinate between stakeholders and development team
- Manage project timeline and milestones
constraints: Must support coordination across all 5 roles
Must enable Product Manager coordination responsibilities

Communication channels and tools are established
Decision-making and escalation processes are documented
Cross-functional workflows are mapped and documented
Status reporting mechanisms are implemented
Stakeholder communication protocols are defined
Framework is reviewed and approved by Product Manager and Technical Lead
Team onboarding to communication framework is completed
